WITH film_copy_counts AS (
  SELECT f.film_id, f.rating, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS copy_count
  FROM film AS f
  LEFT JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id
  GROUP BY f.film_id, f.rating
), deviations AS (
  SELECT film_id, rating, copy_count,
         copy_count - AVG(copy_count) OVER (PARTITION BY rating) AS diff_from_rating_avg,
         copy_count - AVG(copy_count) OVER () AS diff_from_overall_avg
  FROM film_copy_counts
)
SELECT film_id, rating, copy_count, diff_from_rating_avg, diff_from_overall_avg
FROM deviations
ORDER BY diff_from_overall_avg DESC
LIMIT 10
